subtitulo: Voices in defense of the Earth

conservacao.descricao_geral: Livro em bom estado, embora um pouco marcado pelo uso. Texto sem anotações ou sublinhados. Papel amarelado pelo tempo.  / As the destruction of nature reaches new extremes, resistance becomes ever more militant. Radical environmental groups are front-page news. From laboratory bombings to the destruction of ski resorts, this emerging militancy has been truly upping the political ante. This anthology features a range of voices from these groups - from academics to armed revolutionaries - and explores this new political struggle. The first book of its kind on this increasingly important topic.
